relationships.subject: capsaicin
relationships.evidence_quote: activating the TRPV1 channel in the spinal cord using capsaicin, a TRPV1 agonist, results in mechanical and thermal hypersensitivity

relationships.subject: TRPV1
relationships.evidence_quote: our findings suggest that TRPV1 activation induces neuronal apoptosis, neuroinflammation and mitochondrial dysfunction in the spinal cord

relationships.subject: TRPV1
relationships.evidence_quote: TRPV1 activation impaired mitochondrial function in terms of oxygen consumption, collapsed the mitochondrial membrane potential (Ψm) and induction of the mitochondrial permeability transition pore (mPTP)

relationships.subject: AMG9810
relationships.evidence_quote: injection of the TRPV1 antagonist, AMG9810, into the spinal cord following sciatic nerve crush reversed mechanical allodynia and modulated thermal hypersensitivity

relationships.subject: AMG9810
relationships.evidence_quote: the presence of the TRPV1 antagonist AMG9810 along with capsaicin and Ca2+ during challenging the spinal cord tissue completely prevents early mPTP induction

key_findings: Spinal TRPV1 activation by capsaicin causes hypersensitivity, apoptosis, neuroinflammation and mitochondrial dysfunction (mPTP induction, reduced membrane potential and oxygen consumption).
TRPV1 antagonist AMG9810 reversed mechanical allodynia after sciatic nerve crush and prevented mPTP induction.
